proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4994 *chapp section 1 gives chāp seal/stamp; Platts p. 455 explicitly defines chāp as a seal or signet. Survey chāp/chap ring is compared with the signet noun, retaining the broader elicited ring sense and the open intra-Indo-Aryan transmission route. This is not the unrelated roof word returned by the first search. Exact survey form cʰap is preserved.
